text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, with Shinko Windy's debut<n>race
approaching...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ears up, Lackey! I've cooked up a<n>plan that'll
really make me POP at my<n>debut!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As you already know, dirt doesn't get<n>too much
attention, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I told ya that I'm gonna grab<n>more
headlines than any of 'em turf<n>runners. Problem is,
I can't do that<n>through effort alone.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Right? Which means I gotta get<n>everyone paying
attention to dirt<n>before they start paying attention to
me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I decided I'm gonna<n>make a movie
about dirt!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I even got the script done already.<n>It's directed and
starred by me! And<n>don't worry, I wrote in a little
part for<n>you too. See for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only did she prepare a script,<n>she's got the
budget, special effects,<n>and even staff numbers
planned out.<n>She'd have a real blockbuster in her
hands if it weren't an impossible feat.
choice_data_list: (I'm impressed by her ambition and drive, though...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Pure gold, ain't it? Once this beaut<n>hits the big
screen, it'll bring in the<n>golden age of dirt racing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with that face?! You<n>don't think the
plan's brilliant or<n>somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's just no way she's going to<n>get this
playing in theaters. But I<n>don't want to let her
efforts go to<n>waste, so...
choice_data_list: I know! Let's make it into a short commercial!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't see a feature-length film<n>actually happening,
but a commercial<n>is totally within our ability. We'll
make<n>an advertisement for dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Hmmm... Okay...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad! Turns out ya got somethin'<n>between the
ears, Lackey! Or should I<n>say...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Diabolical strategist!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You heard me! All right! Enough<n>planning! Time for
action!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! These stills are spot-on! Which<n>means next
up is...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Scouting a location! Good thing I've<n>got an eye for
visual composition!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, what was the next step again?<n>...Right, I need
to download a video<n>editing software and choose
some<n>background music...
choice_data_list: I'll take care of the rest.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You sure? Then I'll leave it to ya.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Things are going real<n>smooth, eh? You're
not doing so bad<n>yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true. She's handled the bulk of<n>the work. I've
only pitched in here<n>and there. Once Shinko Windy
gets an<n>idea, there's no stopping her...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Today, I'mma film a buncha extras<n>running. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is that you, Windy? Heeey! Oh,<n>what're you
recording?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few dirt Umamusume, apparently in<n>the middle of
training, come up to us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First is Smart Falcon, an Umamusume<n>who dreams
of dazzling on stage as<n>an Umadol. The next is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Put that away! You can't just<n>spring a
camera on a local idol when<n>she's all sweaty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae, a "local idol" who<n>loves her
hometown Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ How about we do a cute<n>pose for your
video?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Not what I'm looking for. Go and do a<n>little running
for me, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? What for?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you asked! I'm shooting<n>a promo to
make dirt races super<n>popular!
A video to make dirt races popular?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey Rickey, hey Acute!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to attract more<n>viewers? If so, feng
shui can help<n>you do the job! I'm certain feng shui
methods are suitable for capturing<n>images too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Copano Rickey, an upbeat<n>Umamusume who
wants to bring<n>everyone good luck with feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, dearie, but... what is this<n>"promo" you
speak of? Will it help<n>increase the amount of dirt
spectators?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And this is Wonder Acute, a calm and<n>caring
Umamusume with an<n>indomitable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh, guess I gotta spell it out for ya.<n>Here's the
rundown...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Really?! You're doing that much for allus dirt runners?! That's so sweet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're a real go-getter. I'm sure all<n>the other dirt
racers will be super<n>happy to hear about what
you're<n>doing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you've had your nose<n>buried in that
notebook so much<n>recently. I would be happy to
lend a<n>hand, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! The more the merrier, right?!<n>☆ Let's
make dirt the talk of the town!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! These guys know what's up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That settles it! Let's make this promo<n>together!
Then, we can show it on<n>one of those jumbo
screens in the<n>middle of town!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You mean like one of those<n>jumbotrons? Ummm...
about that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Windy... you know, it takes a lot ofmoney to buy ad time on thosescreens, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nrgh?! 'C-course I knew that!<n>Everybody knows
that! I was just<n>throwing the idea out there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-well? What do you think we shoulddo then?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Relax, relax! ☆ There's plenty of other<n>ways to get
the video out.<n>Umastagram's a good place to start,
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and with any luck, it'll go viral.<n>We can all post
it through each of our<n>own accounts to start out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That... makes a lot of sense!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, is that how it's done? I was<n>about to suggest
we upload it to the<n>academy's home web page.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, that might work... Making it<n>look official is a
stronger angle than<n>you'd think!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Passing off an amateur video as<n>official could be
funny. Plus, people<n>would understand once they
knew it<n>was made by students.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You're all such good little<n>lackeys! Listen to
all these great<n>ideas you're coming up with!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is gonna be epic! I can feel it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, off to the student council office<n>to start
negotiating!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't she just full of beans? I<n>wonder if it's
because her debut race<n>was confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... This qi feels quite positive. I<n>sense a new
current making its way<n>toward the dirt league!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was worried she was just a<n>prankster, but it's
clear she's gotten<n>serious.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! I'm happy to see she's<n>become a hard
worker.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We won't be debuting in time to join<n>her on the
track just yet... but I'm<n>really excited to go and root
for her<n>instead! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! ♪ This is the room, right? I'm<n>comin' in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No knock? I thought all the<n>student council
members were doing<n>work off campus today...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How suspicious!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dang it! No one's here...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Stop! Windy! What are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Barging into the student council room<n>when the
members are absent is<n>against the rules!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If it isn't Biko. What are you<n>yappin' about
now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Biko Pegasus, an<n>Umamusume who fights
for justice,<n>loves the hero Carrot Ranger, and has<n>a
battery that never quits!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I won't let you get in the way<n>of my master
plan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Master plan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Keh, keh, keh! Prepare to be floored<n>once you learn
why I've come here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting ready to strike fear into<n>the whole
racing world!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! How could you be so<n>cruel?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I knew you had a thing for pranks,<n>but... Windy... are
you actually an<n>evildoer?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'm bad! The baddest of<n>the bad!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh! You're... an evil Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I do not wish to fight you... But as an<n>ally of justice,
I cannot sit idly by!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear some commotion coming from<n>outside the
student council room.<n>Wait, I know that voice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
URGGGHHH! Cut it out already! If<n>you've got a
score to settle with me,<n>let's do it on the track! I'll
make you<n>eat my dust!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge! Once I win,<n>I'll have you
put an end to your evil<n>plan—for good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rush in to defuse the situation. I think<n>the
misunderstanding has been<n>cleared up, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy... you've finally shown your<n>true colors.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Therefore... I'll be keeping a close<n>eye on you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of keeping the peace at<n>our beloved
academy, I will never<n>look away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: For real?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Farewell! Until we meet again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Did you hear that just now?!<n>She's basically
declared herself my<n>number one fan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Keh, keh, keh... My evil deeds are<n>being
acknowledged already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus seems to be an<n>Umamusume we
should keep our<n>eyes on. Chances are that she and
Shinko Windy will clash on the track<n>sooner or later!
